name: CAST AI
tagline: CAST AI watches a Kubernetes cluster and automatically resizes nodes, switches to cheaper spot instances, and rightsizes workloads to cut cloud spend without a human tuning each setting by hand. Cloud architects use it to keep a multi-cloud Kubernetes bill under control without turning cost optimization into a full-time job.
